PLAN "12-Week Couch to 5K Plan"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "progressive cardiovascular fitness toward 5K"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Introductory run-walk"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 1 minute x 4 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 4 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
          calf_raise 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Gentle cardio and mobility"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 1 minute x 3 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 45m "Run-walk combo"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
  WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progressive run-walk"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2 minutes x 4 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walk 90 seconds x 4 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Mobility and light jog"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Longer cardio block"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 3 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
  WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Steady build"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 3 minutes x 4 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 4 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Active recovery + mobility"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 3 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 55m "Longer intervals"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 4 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
  WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Progress test week 1"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 5 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Mobility and light jog"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 3 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Long run focus"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 6 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Build aerobic base"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 4 minutes x 4 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 4 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Tempo-ish effort bouts"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 5 minutes x 3 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 65m "Progression run"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 8 minutes x 2 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Build pace"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 6 minutes x 3 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Mobility + light jog"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 4 minutes x 4 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 4 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 70m "Longer steady state"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 10 minutes x 2 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 65m "8K readiness focus"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 12 minutes x 2 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Intervals and form"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 4 minutes x 4 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 4 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 75m "Progression push"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 6 minutes x 3 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Mid-plan tune-up"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 8 minutes x 3 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 3 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Tempo continue"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 6 minutes x 4 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 4 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 80m "Long run prep"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 12 minutes x 2 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Taper start"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 10 minutes x 2 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Light tempo"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 8 minutes x 2 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Race-specific prep"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 6 minutes x 2 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 14:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Race-week warm-up"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 4 minutes x 2 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Easy jog + mobility"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 3 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          walk 2 minutes x 2 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 30m "5K race day readiness"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 5 minutes x 3 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walk 1 minute x 3 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: 3x8..12 rpe 7
- Sets always come first: 3x10 means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: 3x8..12 rpe 7
- Rest in seconds: rest 90 seconds

EXERCISE VOCABULARY (use ONLY canonical names):
push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, cable_row, seated_row, lat_pulldown, cable_pulldown, bicep_curl, hammer_curl, concentration_curl, preacher_curl, tricep_dip, tricep_extension, tricep_pushdown, skull_crusher, face_pull, rear_delt_fly, lateral_raise, front_raise, dumbbell_fly, cable_fly, chest_fly, pec_deck, shrug, upright_row, squat, front_squat, goblet_squat, sumo_squat, split_squat, lunge, walking_lunge, reverse_lunge, lateral_lunge, deadlift, romanian_deadlift, sumo_deadlift, trap_bar_deadlift, leg_press, hack_squat, leg_curl, leg_extension, calf_raise, seated_calf_raise, standing_calf_raise, glute_bridge, hip_thrust, step_up, box_jump, jump_squat, hip_abduction, hip_adduction, good_morning, plank, side_plank, plank_up, crunch, bicycle_crunch, reverse_crunch, sit_up, v_up, russian_twist, wood_chop, leg_raise, hanging_leg_raise, lying_leg_raise, mountain_climber, dead_bug, bird_dog, ab_wheel, ab_rollout, hollow_hold, hollow_rock, toe_touch, pallof_press, superman, back_extension, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, bear_crawl, crab_walk, inchworm, hamstring_stretch, quad_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, calf_stretch, achilles_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, tricep_stretch, lat_stretch, back_stretch, spinal_twist, neck_stretch, neck_roll, butterfly_stretch, frog_stretch, pigeon_pose, child_pose, cat_cow, forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, figure_four_stretch, wrist_circles, ankle_rolls, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing

CARDIO MODALITIES:
running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking

Note: For running sessions, use walking/recovery paces as needed to accommodate asthma management. Prioritize proper warmups and cool-downs.
